Ligand of 8EFQ (mOR-DAMGO-Gi), a deposition used nowhere else in this project and from a different paper than 8F7Q/8F7R. muOR pKi 8.88, the highest in Wang 2023 Table S2. C26H35N5O6, MW 513.60, stereocentres S/R/S = L-Tyr / D-Ala / L-N-MePhe. Built from SMILES because N-methyl-Phe and the C-terminal glycinol have no one-letter code. Synthetic analogue: held-out target only, never a template.

Self-retrieval control for template B (its own ligand, 8F7R chain P). Formerly the E4 held-out target; promoted to template by docs/dual_template_design.md, so it is a C1-style self-retrieval check here, NOT independent evidence.
Self-retrieval control carried over from C1. Endogenous (PENK), muOR pKi 7.40. Not the ligand of either template: 8F7Q resolves beta-endorphin, of which YGGFM is the first five residues.

Highest-affinity endogenous muOR ligand with no mOR-bound structure (pKi 7.97). Candidate only - it can never be a template here. Included so both templates are tested against an endogenous ligand neither was built from.
